The Dix-Hallpike maneuver is negative, which rules out BPPV, but the presence of nystagmus and bilateral decreased hearing suggests an inner ear pathology. Given the recent cold and constant vertigo, I suspect Vestibular Neuritis or Labyrinthitis, but the hearing loss points more toward Labyrinthitis.
